summary: Scarborough Community Council will introduce bills.
decided: General Bills Scarborough Community Council passed By-laws 381-2025 and 382-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Scarborough Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 383-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
